approach: a global option, one the base command declares, is accepted before the command path and between a group and its sub-command as well as after the command (axi-native RFC sections 3.2 and 3.4)

the command path is matched from the positionals before the first option, then from the tokens each global option does not take as its value; the arity comes from the base lookup, so a global option's value is never read as a command name
a command's own option before the command ends the path, so it stays a usage error as today; the terminator still ends it

an invocation that worked before gives the same output, except one: a default command with an argument, given a global option and then a token naming a command (app --verbose show), now runs that command, as app show does; every other change turns a usage error into a working invocation
scenarios added to the frozen input-parsing and execution suites; no existing scenario changed
